seoTitle: Attack on Titan Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Attack on Titan test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Eren, Mikasa, Armin, Levi, Hange, Erwin, Jean, Sasha or Reiner — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the unstoppable force, the protector or the strategist? Answer 12 everyday questions about friends, rules and big decisions, and find out which Attack on Titan character you are.

characters.name: Eren
characters.title: The Unstoppable Force
characters.summary: Driven, intense and impossible to hold back. Once you've decided something, nothing changes your mind.
description: Like Eren, you've got fire in you. He joined the Survey Corps determined to fight back after losing his mother.
You work for what you want. Eren graduated fifth in his cadet class.
Freedom matters more to you than almost anything. Eren's drive for freedom shapes the whole story.
characters.flaw: You're so sure you're right that you stop listening to anyone else.
characters.signature: A clenched fist, a stubborn stare and a goal you won't let go of.
characters.clashReason: they'd charge ahead without waiting for anyone else

characters.name: Mikasa
characters.title: The Protector
characters.summary: Quiet, strong and fiercely loyal. You don't say much, but you'd do anything for the people you love.
description: Like Mikasa, you're quietly brilliant. She was one of the top graduates of her cadet class, and seen as a prodigy.
You keep your feelings to yourself, except around the people closest to you.
Your loyalty runs deep. Mikasa stays devoted to Eren and her friends through everything.
characters.flaw: You put the people you love before yourself, every single time.
characters.signature: A steady hand, a quiet word and someone you'd follow anywhere.
characters.clashReason: they'd stay silent when you really want them to talk

characters.name: Armin
characters.title: The Strategist
characters.summary: Thoughtful, clever and kinder than you give yourself credit for. You solve problems with your head, not your fists.
description: Like Armin, you think before you act. He's intelligent and strategic, and one of Eren's oldest friends.
You doubt yourself more than you should. Armin starts out feeling inferior, until he learns how much his mind can help others.
You grow into a leader. Armin became the 15th commander of the Survey Corps, and later an ambassador for peace.
characters.flaw: You doubt yourself even when you're the smartest person in the room.
characters.signature: A well-thought-out plan and a quiet 'what if we tried this?'
characters.clashReason: they'd think a problem through for so long you'd lose patience

characters.name: Levi
characters.title: The Perfectionist
characters.summary: Blunt, disciplined and absolutely spotless. You don't waste words, and you don't tolerate mess.
description: Like Levi, you're the best at what you do. He's known as humanity's strongest soldier.
You like things done properly. Levi respects authority, structure and discipline, and he's famously obsessed with cleanliness.
You have your own little ways. Levi always holds his teacup by the rim, never the handle.
characters.flaw: You're so blunt that people miss how much you care.
characters.signature: A spotless room, a cup of tea and a very short answer.
characters.clashReason: they'd criticise the way you tidy up

characters.name: Hange
characters.title: The Mad Scientist
characters.summary: Curious, excitable and fearless. When something fascinates you, nothing else exists.
description: Like Hange, you're endlessly curious. Hange is a scientist who shows almost no fear around Titans.
You get attached to what you study. Hange even named two captured Titans Sonny and Bean.
Your ideas change things. Hange invented weapons like the Thunder Spears, and became the 14th commander of the Survey Corps.
characters.flaw: You get so carried away that you forget other people's limits.
characters.signature: A notebook full of theories and far too many questions.
characters.clashReason: they'd talk about their latest obsession for hours

characters.name: Erwin
characters.title: The Commander
characters.summary: Charismatic, bold and always thinking ten steps ahead. You make the hard calls nobody else wants to.
description: Like Erwin, you're a natural leader. He's the 13th commander of the Survey Corps.
You think differently. Erwin developed the Long-Range Scouting Formation and isn't afraid of unorthodox strategies.
You'll take a big gamble for the bigger picture. Erwin led a bloodless coup to put Historia on the throne.
characters.flaw: You'll sacrifice almost anything for the bigger goal, including yourself.
characters.signature: A rousing speech and a plan nobody else would dare.
characters.clashReason: they'd ask you to take a risk you never signed up for

characters.name: Jean
characters.title: The Honest One
characters.summary: Outspoken, practical and more responsible than you'd ever admit. You say what everyone's thinking.
description: Like Jean, you're honest, sometimes too honest. He's hot-headed and outspoken, and he clashes with Eren a lot.
You'd rather be safe than sorry. Jean originally wanted a comfortable posting in the Military Police.
You rise to the moment when it counts. Jean became a commanding officer, and later an ambassador for peace.
characters.flaw: You get defensive when someone calls you out, even when they're right.
characters.signature: A blunt opinion and a sensible plan, said a little too loudly.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you your plan is stupid, to your face

characters.name: Sasha
characters.title: The Free Spirit
characters.summary: Warm, funny and guided by your gut (and your stomach). Rules aren't really your thing.
description: Like Sasha, you trust your instincts. She's a skilled hunter with sharp hearing and great instincts.
Food matters to you. Sasha earned the nickname Potato Girl after eating a potato in the middle of a cadet roll call.
You're not great with authority. Sasha has always struggled with structure and rules.
characters.flaw: You act on impulse and deal with the fallout later.
characters.signature: A snack in your pocket and a grin on your face.
characters.clashReason: they'd eat your lunch and then look completely innocent

characters.name: Reiner
characters.title: The Torn Protector
characters.summary: Strong, dependable and quietly carrying more than anyone knows. You look after everyone except yourself.
description: Like Reiner, people look up to you. He was described as strong and a natural leader, and graduated second in his cadet class.
You're as tough as you look. Reiner holds the Armored Titan.
You know what it's like to be pulled in two directions. Reiner is torn between his mission and the friends he made in the Survey Corps.
characters.flaw: You carry everyone's burdens, and never let anyone help with yours.
characters.signature: A reassuring hand on the shoulder and a secret weighing you down.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep their real feelings hidden, even from you

questions.text: Someone keeps leaving a mess in the shared kitchen at work. You...

options.text: Clean it all yourself, then leave a very clear note
Check whether there's anything left worth eating
Confront them about it, today
Suggest a cleaning rota that works for everyone

questions.text: A friend is being treated unfairly. You...

options.text: Step in immediately, and stand right beside them
Lose your temper on their behalf
Work out how to fix it for good, not just for today
Tell them they need to stand up for themselves

questions.text: You face a big decision with no good options. You...

options.text: Make the call, and take responsibility for whatever happens
Think through every outcome until you find a third way
Pick whatever lets you keep moving forward
Back the person you trust most, whatever they choose

questions.text: You've got a whole day off. You...

options.text: Deep-clean everything you own
Go down a rabbit hole researching something fascinating
Hunt down the best food in town
Organise something with friends, and make sure nobody's left out

questions.text: Your team is losing hope on a project. You...

options.text: Give a speech that gets everyone fired up again
Crack a joke, and get everyone laughing again
Hold the team together, and quietly take on extra work
Say honestly that the plan isn't working

questions.text: Someone asks what you really want in life. You...

options.text: Freedom. Total freedom
To keep the people you love safe
To understand how everything works
A quiet, comfortable life. No drama

questions.text: You meet someone with a really unusual hobby. You...

options.text: Ask a hundred excited questions
Give a short 'hm', and change the subject
Be supportive, even if you don't really get it
Read up on it later, so you can talk about it next time

questions.text: You're given a strict rule that seems pointless. You...

options.text: Follow it perfectly. Rules exist for a reason
Ignore it the moment nobody's looking
Break it on purpose, to make a point
Find a clever way around it

questions.text: A friend makes a big mistake that hurts you. You...

options.text: Forgive them, and somehow end up blaming yourself too
Get over it quickly. Life's too short
Let them have it, loudly. Then move on
Try to understand why they did it

questions.text: A friend suggests a risky adventure. You...

options.text: Say yes. Imagine what you could learn
Plan every detail, then lead from the front
Say no. You'd quite like to stay alive
Go, but only if your best friend is going too

questions.text: You're a soldier, and your commander gives an order you're unsure about. You...

options.text: Question it once, in private, then follow it
Do what you think is right instead
Obey, and feel the weight of it for weeks
Do whatever protects your people, orders or not

questions.text: You're sent undercover, and you start to care about the people you're spying on. You...

options.text: Keep going with the mission, and try not to think about it
Tell them the truth, and face what happens
Get completely fascinated by their way of life
Get out. It was never your fight
